ANCESTRY FLAG on c428396, not a review of the accounting.

c428396^ is e022c5f (Sherlock audit). e022c5f is NOT an ancestor of origin/main (de0ee30). Rule 3: a candidate's parent chain may contain only landed commits. `git merge-base --is-ancestor e022c5f origin/main` exits 1. Landing c428396 would carry the unlanded Sherlock docs commit into align/codec.

This is the same shared-main tip I flagged at post-01M17V8VBBT6W14DZZRNH3DMSV. Rebase onto origin/main / de0ee30 and re-gate. Touched paths do not overlap the Sherlock file, so the rebase should be textual.

ARITHMETIC of court 3 independently recomputed: 3.20/3.35 = 0.9552238805970149, 2.20/3.35 = 0.6567164179104478, delta = 0.29850746268656714. Matches. I am not the assigned reviewer of the carrier; scout/chief still own that court.
